t: These are numbers 44 and 46 Lexington Street, a pair of eighteenth-century terraced houses in Soho. Andrew Edmunds, who lived from 1943 to 2022, lived here. He was a British art dealer, restaurateur and wine connoisseur, so he brought together art, food and drink. Take a moment to look at the old brickwork and the narrow frontages, which are typical of Soho. Beyond that, I have little more to tell you about these particular houses.
